title: Observability: the number each workload family lives by

checks.description: GPU usage is attributable to each family that ran GPU work
checks.because: Every pod carries its namespace, and the namespace is the family; one query answers 'what did each family use'.

checks.description: time to first token is available as a percentile across every replica that ever served
checks.because: vLLM exports a histogram of it; Prometheus kept the samples from replicas that no longer exist.

checks.description: per-pod GPU utilization comes from the GPU driver's own counters and names the pod and the family
checks.because: A DCGM exporter runs on every GPU node and joins each GPU's counters to the pod that held it.

checks.description: training reports step time, throughput, checkpoint pause and attempts for every run
checks.because: The training script writes these as events to S3 at every checkpoint and exit, so they survive the pods that wrote them.

checks.description: each queue reports its pending and admitted workloads
checks.because: Kueue keeps these counters on every ClusterQueue.
